description: This Java class, RenderContentTransform, implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering content as text within an OFBiz web application. It handles retrieving content, encoding XML if necessary, and providing edit links for content management.

classes.name: RenderContentTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform model that renders content as text, optionally with editing capabilities, for use in OFBiz content web applications.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that renders content as text, handles XML escaping, and provides editing link wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, including optional XML escaping and error handling.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wrappes the content with a div for editing, based on the style.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the editing wrapper with an 'Edit' link leading to the content editing page.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS style for edit wrapping, defaulting as needed.
